  \caption{DC drive compliance of the control amplifier, as a map of the unity-gain tracking error over commanded output voltage and load current. Positive $I_{\mathrm{LOAD}}$ draws current out of the output, so the amplifier \emph{sources}; negative $I_{\mathrm{LOAD}}$ injects, so it \emph{sinks}. The colour scale is clipped at \(\pm\SI{50}{\milli\volt}\), which is the compliance criterion: inside the envelope the error is the smooth $I_{\mathrm{LOAD}}R_{\mathrm{OUT,CL}}$ gradient, and outside it the output has hit a rail and the error jumps by more than a volt, so everything beyond the envelope saturates to solid colour. The two black curves are the \(|V_{\mathrm{OUT}}-V_{\mathrm{MAP}}|=\SI{50}{\milli\volt}\) edges, interpolated on the \SI{50}{\nano\ampere} sweep at each of the 26 commanded voltages; that they land on the boundary of the graded band is a check that the map and the envelope were derived independently. The vertical axis is cropped to \(\pm\SI{8}{\micro\ampere}\); the envelope never exceeds that inside the tracking range. \textbf{This is the ff corner with typical resistors} --- see Table~\ref{tab:ctrlamp-drivemap} and the note below it.}
  \label{fig:ctrlamp-drivemap}
